mailText:
For the Attention of - [[ApplicantName]] 

Re: Invitation to Join Platinum Club - [[ApplicantCompany]]  

We write further to our recent conversation concerning our debt collection services. 

We note that you require assistance with a number of overdue customers annually. Additionally, you have indicated that having outsourced a debt you would not usually engage in future credit dealings with the customer.

Having considered the position therefore we are pleased to advise that you qualify for, and indeed we recommend, our Platinum Club Membership service as being the most appropriate for your needs. 

Platinum Club is a Credit Management Solution available exclusively through Direct Route. It is offered to suitably qualifying clients "By Invitation Only". 

As a Platinum Club Member you will receive zero cost debt recovery, inclusive of court issue and enforcement fees on qualifying debts (irrespective of value) as well a range of important other benefits.    

If you have received this email then great news...you have already been pre-qualified for Platinum Club Membership. This communication is your formal invitation to join. 

To accept your Platinum Club Membership invitation: 

1. Follow this link [[MembershipFormLink]] to complete your Platinum Club Membership Application Form, and  
 
2. Set up your standing order for your £30.00 monthly subscription (£25.00+Vat). 

Our Bank Details are: Sort Code 12 24 81, Account Number 06368001, Account Name - Direct Route Collections Limited. 

To Get Things Moving Today: 
Once you have set up your standing order through your own online banking simply send a screen shot of the confirmation screen to newdebts@directroute.co.uk.   

What Happens Next?

Once we receive your Membership Application Form [[MembershipFormLink]] and completed standing order we will instantly process your application, activate your Platinum Club Membership, and send you details of how to begin benefiting from all of your future debts being collected totally free of risk, starting immediately.        

Kindly note that all debt instructions submitted are subject to our [[TermsConditions]].
 
We very much look forward to hearing from you further.
acceptanceText:
Dear [[ApplicantName]] 

We are pleased to advise that your Platinum Club Membership has been approved. 

You may begin instructing us to collect your overdue monies with immediate effect.

Please send copy invoices or statements for all customers you would like chasing to newdebts@directroute.co.uk.

TOP TIP - Experience proves that collection performance times are markedly improved if you are able to provide us with contact name(s), telephone numbers and email addresses for the accounts that you would like us to chase.

As an approved Platinum Club Member you benefit from zero cost debt collection on suitably qualifying debts, with no limit on debt value. If legal action is required then there is no cost outlay risk for you on qualifying debts either, as the Platinum Club funds all court issue and enforcement fees as a key part of the service.  

An invoice to balance your accounting records for your Platinum Club membership will be despatched under separate cover shortly.  

Kindly note that all debt instructions received are subject to our [[TermsConditions]]. 

We very much look forward to your receiving your first instructions and also to successfully recovering monies on your behalf for many years to come.
